 WRITTEN STATEMENT ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANT NO. 01 
 _______________________________________________________________________ _______ 
 
 It is respectfully submitted on behalf of the Defendant as under: 
 
 That absolutely without prejudice to any other objection, averment, submission in this Para-Wise comments, it is submitted that the Plaint is based on the patently false, frivolous and unsubstantiated allegations, on a misleading depiction of the facts comprising of half-truths, speculations and inferences and on an incorrect, misconceived and utterly baseless construction, interpretation of the applicable laws, rules and regulations inter alia on account of the following Preliminary Objections: 
 
 Th at the instant suit is not maintainable as the answering defendant i.e. Zameen.com is not a legal entity capable of being sued. As established under relevant law, that parties to law suit must have legal standing, either as an individual, a corporation, a partnership, or another recognized legal entity, to be a proper party. Given that Defendant No. 01 is merely a brand name and does not possess legal entity status, it inherently lacks the capacity to be sued. The plaintiff's attempt to bring an action against an entity that is non-existent or lacks legal recognition is fundamentally flawed and without legal basis . 
 
 
 That the instant suit is not maintainable in present form as www.zameen.com is website address of Zameen Media having its registered office at Lahore , Whereas Zameen Media (Private) Limited, is a company incorporated under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now Companies Act, 2017) , hence website cannot be treated as a legal entity . 
 
 That the instant suit is not maintainable as the answering Defendant has not been sued through an authorized representative. Legal procedures require that any suit against a defendant must be initiated through proper representation to ensure compliance with due process . 
 
 
 That the instant suit is not maintainable as Zameen Media (Private) Limited has not been impleaded as a party as required under the law. It is imperative to highlight that p laintiff has failed to implead the proper party necessary for the resolution of the claims presented. This oversight means that the current suit cannot proceed as it does not meet the legal requirements for proper parties in a lawsuit. 
 
 That the instant Suit is not maintainable in its present form, since the Plaintiff has concealed material facts from this Honorable Court and inserted false, friv olous implications against the answering defendant , as Defendant No. 01 is neither developer nor owner of the project. It has no concern with the excavation, development and construction of the project. 
 
 
 That the instant suit is not maintainable , since it is bad for misjoinder i.e. Defendant No. 01. The Plaintiff has improperly joined Defendant No. 01 in this action, whereas it is well settled law that all the parties joined in a suit must have a direct and substantial interest in the subject matter. The inclusion of Defendant No. 01 who do not meet this criterion constitutes misjoinder, making the instant suit untenable. 
 
 That the instant suit is not maintainable and liable to be dismiss with exemplary cost, as it is well settled principle that no effective decree or order be passed in the absence of proper or necessary party. 
 
 
 
 That the instant suit is not maintainable in its present form as the Plaintiff has not paid the requisite court fee, as claimed in the Plaint, hence the instant Suit is liable to be dismissed on this ground alone. 
 
 That the instant suit is not maintainable, being devoid of any force, based on misrepresentations, deception, and concealment of facts, as no cause of action has accrued in favor of Plaintiff and against the Defendant, therefore, the instant Suit merits forthwith dismissal under Order VII Rule 11 of the Civil Procedure Code, 1908. 
 
 Without prejudice to the above-mentioned, para-wise reply to the plaint is as follows: - 
 PARAWISE REPLY: 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No.0 1 to 03 are a matter of record hence needs no reply. 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No.04 and 05 are vehemently denied f or being fa l se , frivolous and vexatious &amp; the Plaintiff is put to strict proof thereof. It is imperative to highlight here that no Construction company exist under the name Zameen.com and www.zameen.com is website address of Zameen Media , answering defendant have nothing to do with the excavation, development and construction of the said project , as answering d efe n dant is n either developer nor owner of the said project. 
 That the contents of Paragraph No.06 and 07 are vehemently denied for being untrue , f allacious and devoid of merits &amp; the contents of Paragraph No. 02 of instant reply are reiterated to avoid the repetition. 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No.0 8 and 09 are a matter of record hence needs no reply. 
 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No. 10 are misconceiving &amp; the Plaintiff is put to strict proof thereof and the contents of Paragraph No. 02 of instant reply are reiterated to avoid the repetition. 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No. 11 do not relate to answering defendant, hence needs no reply. 
 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No. 12 are denied for being misleading &amp; the Plaintiff is put to strict proof thereof. 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No. 1 3 are denied for being untrue and vexatious &amp; the Plaintiff is put to strict proof thereof. 
 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No. 14 to 16 are denied for being misconceiving and fallacious &amp; the Plaintiff is put to strict proof thereof. 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No. 17 are a matter of record hence needs no reply. 
 
 
 That the contents of Paragraph No. 18 &amp; prayer clauses are vehemently denied for being incorrect and false &amp; the Plaintiff is put to strict proof thereof. Moreover, contents of the instant reply are reiterated to avoid repetition. 
 
 
 
 PRAYER 
 WHEREOF: In view of the above submissions, it is respectfully submitted that: 
 
 The Instant Suit filed by Plaintiff may kindly be dismissed. 
 
 Direct the Plaintiff to pay the sum of Rs.500, 000/- as to Cost of the Suit being false and vexatious under Section 35A of the Code of Civil Procedure Code, 1908. 
 
 
 Any other relief, which this Honorable Court may deems just, may also be granted in favor of the Respondent.
